# Dayibi Nails

> Nail studio by Dayibi based in Pflugerville, Texas. Gel-X, builder gel, acrylics and hand-sculpted 3D flowers by Dayibi, in her private studio on Spring Hill Ln in Pflugerville. Open every day, by appointment.

## Services
- Gel-X extensions: Uñas Gel-X (Aprés). Soft-gel tips for length that looks natural and light. From $65 · about 90 min.
- Builder gel: Builder Gel en Uñas Naturales. Strength and structure for your own nails. From $65 · about 90 min.
- Acrylic nails: Uñas Acrílicas. Custom acrylic sets with design and finish your way. From $70 · about 90 min.
- Basic manicure: Manicura Básica. Clean shape, precise cuticle work and a glossy gel finish. From $45 · about 40 min.
- Basic pedicure: Pedicura Básica. Beautiful, clean, cared-for feet in gel. From $55 · about 40 min.
- 3D flowers & nail art: Hand-sculpted 3D flowers, crisp French tips, tortoiseshell, rhinestones and gold foil on any set.

## About
Dayibi Nails is Dayibi's own studio, in Suite 1 at 15608 Spring Hill Ln in Pflugerville. One artist, by appointment, every day of the week. Her clients stay. One regular has been with her for more than three years and says she would never change; others talk about the dedication, the care and the love they can see in every detail. The menu is focused: Gel-X, builder gel, acrylics, manicures and pedicures, all prepped with a Russian manicure and finished in gel, with French tips, 3D flowers and custom art on top. Se habla español.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on Dayibi's booking page: pick your service and an open time. You can also call (346) 492-8120.
- Q: ¿Hablan español?
  A: Sí. The service menu is in Spanish and many of Dayibi's clients are Spanish speakers. Everyone is welcome.
- Q: Why do prices say "from"?
  A: Starting prices cover the service itself. Length, design and added decorations like 3D flowers, rhinestones or foil can change the final price.
- Q: I have nails from another salon. Can you take them off?
  A: Yes. If nails or product from another professional need to be removed first, there's a $30 removal charge for the extra time.
- Q: What's the difference between Gel-X and builder gel?
  A: Gel-X adds length with soft-gel tips. Builder gel goes on your natural nails to strengthen and protect them. Both take about 90 minutes and finish in gel polish.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 15608 Spring Hill Ln, Suite 1, Pflugerville, TX 78660. Open every day, by appointment.
